title: Here are just a few amazing french fry options in Northern Colorado - NewsBreak
text:
By Sadie Young ,
13 minutes ago
I’m currently on a health kick, which means I’m only thinking about food. Like, all the time. Now I’m reminiscing about my favorite food categories, and French fries are right up there because I love them so much.
So let’s break down the best French fries in Northern Colorado.
Fort Collins Options One thing that’s commonly known about Fort Collins is the fact that there are some killer restaurants. So good it’s sometimes hard to choose only one. But if we’re talking about French fries, I’m going to have to go with the amazing Colorado Room .
Sometimes I want fancy French fries, and the Colorado Room definitely delivers the goods with their specialty flavor like Parmesan truffle fries, buffalo fries, or my personal favorite, the Cajin fries.
Loveland Options Everyone needs comfort fries. I believe comfort fries will heal the world. That’s why if you’re in Loveland, you definitely need to stop by McGraff’s American Grill . What are comfort fries? They would definitely put a stop to your bikini dreams.
Comfort fries come loaded with melted cheese, bacon, green onions, and ranch dressing. And honestly, it makes me wonder if I even need to go to the pool this summer.
Greeley Options You must get to Greeley and visit Sexy Sammies Chicken Sandwiches & Tenders because the fries are only one of many delectable sins they offer. This Greeley staple has been serving some of the best French fries I’ve ever had, cooked until golden brown and crispy. Also, be sure to try one of their house dipping sauces.
Why does everything sound so dang good when you are trying to lose weight? Sigh.
